description: A wavefolder for two signals: each is folded back on itself four times over and then hard clipped

params.text: Sets how far the signal is driven into the folds, 0.9 to 10
Attenuverts the voltage at the Gain jack before it is added to the Gain knob, -100 to 100 per cent
Shifts the signal before it is folded, -5V to 5V, which moves the folds off centre and brings in even harmonics
Attenuverts the voltage at the Symm jack before it is added to the Symm knob, -100 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The first signal to be folded, one per channel
The second signal to be folded, one per channel
Modulates the folding, scaled by the Gain CV knob; the size of the voltage is used rather than its sign, so a negative voltage folds as much as a positive one
Modulates that shift, half a volt per volt scaled by the Symmetry CV knob

outputs.text: The first signal after folding, with its constant offset removed
The second signal after folding, with its constant offset removed

notes: each side is computed only while both its input and its output carry cables, and nothing is normalled from one side to the other

inputs.2:
unipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
